notes.message: query groupByTitle: this lookup does not pin an authorized row's id; matching a name does not prove uniqueness or absence. The server may return matches but cannot certify complete. The held replacement (check --verbose) keeps the same matches and shape on the device; it requires acquired coverage and has no server fallback. Keep the original query if server lookup is required
notes.rewrite:
query groupByTitle(title: text) held:
  return first(conversations where .kind = 'group' and .title = title first 1 by .id)

notes.message: query searchMessages: when the search text folds to no words, the page over messages[..] by read or declaration on messages (deleted, at, id) at schema.q:413:10 is never `complete` — the read rule `exists members[.conversation, viewer]` reads .conversation, which the scan does not pin, so the server cannot tell "no more" from "more you may not read"
notes.rewrite: pin .conversation with where equalities as well as the current equality prefix, choosing the intended scope (this narrows the answer); the existing index `read or declaration on messages (conversation, deleted, at, id) at schema.q:455:16: conversation, deleted, at, id` supports it; or read the page on the device

notes.message: maintain unreadCounts may disclose the delta of a hidden messages row: insert/delete and a potentially wider update rule affect this readable target; filter/key/value dependencies: conversation, deleted, ordinal, sender
notes.rewrite: treat the view as a declared read channel; restrict its read rule or the source update rule if the delta is private

notes.message: posts: each contributing commit logs and streams the whole parent image per destination partition, coalesced once per row; a 4,000-byte parent costs every holder about 4 KB per change
notes.rewrite: use a column when readers want the count with the row; for a large row or a counter changing far more often than it is read, use a view with online only

notes.message: query people `profiles matching q first 20 by .handle after c` reads profiles by .handle, .id, oldest first (index [handle]); its sync window is last 2000 by .id, newest first (index byId [id]); the client needs the server for this read; offline coverage is unknown
notes.rewrite: The window uses .id, newest first (index byId [id]); preserve all predicates, audience keys and the cursor. No paste-ready replacement is available for this read; retain its enclosing row or merge context

scaleSummary: scale: 35 of 54 operations are constant; 5 constant once background cleanup catches up (home, stopTyping, history, messageReactions, setReaction); 14 grow with data (people, typingIn, inboxTyping, inbox, messageReceipts, groupByTitle, delivered, searchMessages, searchChat, searchGrouped, apiHistory, trending, unreadFor, dailyDigest); 1 job(s) assessed per chunk — `check --cost` gives the certificate

search.message: Inferred server audience members[principal = viewer] by .conversation. Device execution keeps the bare held-row scan. every authorized membership and head must be discovered in each server read before a globally ordered hit can be emitted; this compact plan refuses E_SEARCH_OPEN on an opening cut, without a continuation; reset the cursor when switching to grouped reads
search.rewrite: return members[principal = viewer] after c first 20 by .conversation, .id where exists (messages[conversation = .conversation, deleted = false] matching q by .at, .id) { conversation, hits: messages[conversation = .conversation, deleted = false] matching q last 3 by .at, .id }
